description: This PHP source file defines the ValidationException class used in the OrangeHRM software project. The class extends InvalidArgumentException and encapsulates details about validation errors, including the input and validation rule involved.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for validation errors, including context of the input and validation rule involved.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with input data, the rule that failed validation, and an optional message.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input data associated with the validation error.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data associated with the validation error.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Returns the validation rule that was violated.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Sets the validation rule that was violated.
